create_lmcache_connector: create an LMCacheConnectorV1 instance with vllm_config, role, and kv_cache_config for KV cache transfer
run_start_load_kv: run start_load_kv to begin async loading of KV cache from LMCache into vLLM's paged buffer
run_save_kv_layer: run save_kv_layer to asynchronously save a KV cache layer from vLLM to LMCache storage
build_connector_meta: build connector metadata from scheduler output for KV transfer coordination
aggregate_kv_events: aggregate LMCacheKVEvents to retain common KV cache events across workers
